items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Every weekend we‟d come to my basement, Hal Macussi, O.C. Johnson, Al Cohen, and Art Farmer. We‟d come down there and we had this very hard music.

ctx.x: Oh, he was just absolutely terrible. Al was a nice guy that we could work for. My uncle worked for him. Let me tell you about that too a little later. That‟s where I got all these scars on me, working for Al Capone. That‟s right.
